notes:
- New: real-time Alerts actually fire now - a scheduling bug meant no alert, of any timeframe, was ever being evaluated even though everything looked correctly configured. Fixed.
- New: 1-minute timeframe for Basket backtesting and Alerts, matching the 1-minute data the app has downloaded for a while
- New: a genuinely useful Alert Log - every scan leaves a trace (a fired alert, an error, or a quiet "no signal" confirmation), grouped by scan time with the newest batch highlighted at the top, fired alerts show which indicator and length triggered (e.g. "SMA(50)"), and a Clear button resets it
- Fixed: broker credentials (Alpaca, Fyers) now take effect immediately when saved in Broker Settings, instead of silently requiring a full app restart
- Fixed: Alerts and Live Signals always fetched 5-minute data from the broker regardless of a scan's own configured timeframe
- Fixed: a scan failure for every symbol in a batch used to be thrown away completely, indistinguishable from a clean scan that found no signal - failures now summarize right in the Alert Log
- Fixed: Gann Square of 9 levels were off by one angle step (a wrong constant put every level at HALF its correct position on the wheel) - verified against the standard formula, a published reference calculator, and an independent manual calculation
- Fixed: multi-symbol Portfolio/Basket backtests could show a distorted combined equity curve because each symbol's train/test split was computed from that symbol's own day count - every symbol in one run now shares a single common split date
- Small polish: Suggested Portfolio popup now scrolls instead of growing past the screen; Release Notes page is now expandable/collapsible
